items.t: IMS bearing failure
items.job: Replace IMS bearing with upgraded kit (done with clutch and rear main seal)
items.note: This is the preventive job. Once the bearing has failed, the engine usually needs a rebuild or replacement, which can run well over $10,000. Most 2006-2008 engines need to be taken apart to reach the bearing.

items.t: Cylinder bore scoring and oil burning
items.job: Engine rebuild with new cylinder liners and pistons
items.note: UK specialists quote around GBP 10,000-12,000 for a re-lined engine. A good used or remanufactured engine can be an alternative.

items.t: Air-oil separator failure (smoke on start-up)
items.job: Replace air-oil separator and vent hoses
items.note: Some specialists check for a vacuum leak at the same time.

items.t: Rear main seal oil leak
items.job: Replace rear main seal (gearbox removed)
items.note: Labor is the main cost. Done with a clutch or IMS job, the extra labor is small.

items.t: Water pump failure and overheating
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat, refill and bleed coolant
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,690-2,300 for a 911 water pump replacement.

items.t: Cracked coolant expansion tank
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank and cap

items.t: Cracked cylinder head or oil and coolant mixing
items.job: Replace cylinder head (engine removed) or oil cooler
items.note: If only the oil cooler has failed, the repair is far cheaper (about 2-4 hours plus the cooler).

items.t: Coolant pipes separating on Turbo models
items.job: Pin or weld coolant pipes to engine fittings (engine removed)
items.note: Hagerty puts this job at about $2,700.

items.t: Clogged or corroded front radiators and A/C condensers
items.job: Replace one front radiator or A/C condenser
items.note: RepairPal lists radiator replacement on the 911 at about $2,965-3,347. PistonHeads quotes about GBP 800 per condenser.

items.t: Misfire from cracked ignition coils
items.job: Replace ignition coil packs and spark plugs
items.note: Replacing just one coil is cheaper. RepairPal estimates about $893-1,247 for 911 ignition coil replacement.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner and guide wear
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioners and guide pads
items.note: RepairPal lists timing chain tensioner replacement on the 911 at about $2,719-3,475.

items.t: Dropped intake valve seat
items.job: Cylinder head repair or engine rebuild
items.note: Cost depends on how much damage the broken seat caused.

items.t: Front suspension creaks and worn bushings
items.job: Replace front control arm bushings or arms and align
items.note: PistonHeads quotes about GBP 200 for the bush fix.

items.t: Manual gear shift cable breakage
items.job: Replace manual shift cables

items.t: Blue smoke and oil burning from worn valve guides
items.job: Top-end rebuild with new valve guides
items.note: A leak-down test (about 1-2 hours) comes first.

items.t: Clogged secondary air injection (check engine light)
items.job: Clean secondary air passages and replace check valve
items.note: RepairPal lists an air injection check valve on the 911 at about $191-230.

items.t: Oil leaks from valve covers and oil lines
items.job: Reseal valve covers or replace oil line seals

items.t: Clutch master or slave cylinder leak
items.job: Replace clutch slave or master cylinder and bleed

items.t: GT3 engine connecting rod failure (recall)
items.job: Replace engine under recall
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Front hood may not latch (recall)
items.job: Replace front hood lock
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Water in the front footwell from loose A/C drain
items.job: Refit A/C drain pipes and dry carpet
items.note: Damaged control units under the floor would cost much more.

items.t: Engine misfire from coil pack or crank sensor
items.job: Replace ignition coil or crankshaft sensor
items.note: Replacing all six coils costs more; RepairPal estimates about $893-1,247 for 911 coil replacement.

items.t: PDK gearbox warnings or skipped gears
items.job: PDK software update and fluid/filter service
items.note: A failed control unit or clutch pack costs much more.

items.t: Water pump leak on 3.0L turbo
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant

items.t: Airbag control unit capacitor fault (recall)
items.job: Update software and replace airbag control unit as needed
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Seat side airbag may not deploy (recall)
items.job: Replace seat side airbag modules
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Cabriolet and Targa windshield not properly bonded (recall)
items.job: Re-bond windshield
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Windshield and rear window may detach (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace windshield and rear window
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Dashboard can break during passenger airbag deployment (recall)
items.job: Replace dashboard
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Center-lock wheel bolt may fracture (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace center-lock wheel parts
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rearview camera image may not show (recall)
items.job: Update driver assistance software
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Low beams can glare at oncoming drivers (recall)
items.job: Update front-end electronics control module software
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: 12-volt battery going flat when parked
items.job: Replace 12-volt battery

items.t: Reduced power and misfire feel from active engine mount fault
items.job: Replace active engine mount

items.t: Interior rattles and squeaks
items.job: Find and pad or re-clip loose trim
